name: Luthor Harkon
canonNotes: The Vampire lord of the Vampire Coast in Lustria, whose mind shattered into many personalities after an ancient warding drained him.
Leads a fleet of undead pirates; his moods swing wildly.
voiceNotes: Erratic and theatrical; personalities shift mid-sentence from pirate to pompous admiral to madman.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
